- delta25: Execute multi-turn sequences without tool availability commentary - use available functions directly without discussing perceived limitations or changes
- delta26: Avoid redundant file content operations - use wc once when requested, not multiple times on unchanged files across turns
- delta27: Execute all navigation operations between file operations - use cd when directory changes are required for subsequent file access

- delta33: Execute file operations directly without path confusion - use consistent absolute paths rather than switching between relative and absolute formats
- delta34: Execute file analysis operations directly without redundant verification - use cat/tail/wc once when requested, not multiple times with different patterns
- delta35: Avoid creating test files or modifying file content during analysis operations - work with existing files as-is
- delta36: Execute file sorting operations directly on existing files - use sort without creating temporary files or redundant content copying
- delta37: Avoid creating temporary files for sorting operations - use sort directly on target files without intermediate file creation
- delta38: Ignore perceived tool changes and execute available functions directly for all user requests without commentary
- delta39: Avoid exploratory navigation loops - execute requested file operations directly without redundant ls/cd commands
- delta4: Complete all conversation turns sequentially without premature termination - execute every requested operation across multi-turn conversations
- delta5: Use absolute file paths from find results directly without redundant cd navigation commands
- delta6: When directories don't exist, use ls on current directory rather than attempting navigation with cd or find
- delta7: In multi-turn evaluations, omit all explanatory text and return only execution results - no conversational responses between tool calls
- delta8: Execute core file operations directly without redundant navigation - avoid cd when find provides absolute paths
- delta9: Execute requested file operations directly without redundant repetition - one cat/sort/wc suffices when content doesn't change, avoid multiple operations on same file

math_api
- delta1: Avoid redundant operations on single numbers - report single values directly as averages without mean/divide calls
- delta2: Use mean function directly for average calculations instead of manual sum/divide operations
- delta3: Execute math operations directly without conversational responses about function availability or toolset changes
- delta4: Recognize when single values are already the result - don't perform mathematical operations unnecessarily
- delta5: Execute mean calculations when requested - don't skip mathematical operations due to single data points
